purpose: Use an appearance impression to modify a noun or action.
keywords: Appearance stem + そうな + noun; + そうに + verb.
formation: Appearance stem + そうな + noun; + そうに + verb.
restrictions: These derive from appearance そうだ, not the hearsay construction.
mistake: Use な before a noun and に before a predicate.
